query.text:
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @q nvarchar(4000) set @strKey = 'a.ma_unit = ''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_unit) + ''' and a.ma_nt = ''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_nt) + ''' and a.unit_id = ' + rtrim(@unit_id) set @q = ' select id_tt, sum(tt_nt) as da_pb_nt, sum(case when id = ' + rtrim(@id) + ' then tt_nt else 0 end) as da_pb_ct_nt into #datt from ctcq20 a where ' + @strKey + ' and loai_tt = 1 and id_tt in (select id from #v) group by id_tt update #v set da_pb_nt = b.da_pb_nt - b.da_pb_ct_nt, da_pb_ct_nt = b.da_pb_ct_nt, tt_nt = b.da_pb_ct_nt from #v a join #datt b on a.id = b.id_tt' if @xu_ly = 1 begin --Phan bo tu dong set @q = @q + char(13) + 'declare @i int, @phai_tt numeric(19,5), @tien_nt numeric(19,5) select @i = min(stt), @tien_nt = ' + rtrim(@tien_nt) + ' from #v where da_pb_ct_nt = 0 select @tien_nt = @tien_nt - isnull(sum(da_pb_ct_nt), 0) from #datt while @i is not null and @tien_nt > 0 begin select @phai_tt = t_tt_nt - da_pb_nt from #v where stt = @i if @phai_tt > @tien_nt select @phai_tt = @tien_nt, @tien_nt = 0 else select @tien_nt = @tien_nt - @phai_tt update #v set tt_nt = @phai_tt where stt = @i select @i = min(stt) from #v where stt > @i and da_pb_ct_nt = 0 end update #v set tag = 1 where da_pb_ct_nt = 0 and tt_nt > 0 --tt_nt = t_tt_nt - da_pb_nt' end set @q = @q + char(13) + 'drop table #datt update #v set cl_nt = t_tt_nt - da_pb_nt - tt_nt'
set @strKey = @strKey + ' and (tt_yn = 0 or exists(select 1 from ctcq20 x where x.loai_tt = 1 and a.id = x.id_tt and x.id = ' + rtrim(@id) + '))'
exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', '', '0 as tag, row_number() over(order by ngay_ct, so_ct, id) as stt', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, @q, 0, 0, @@admin, @@userId

dir.script:
select * into #pchi from ctquy20 where id = @id and ma_unit = @ma_unit and ma_nt = @ma_nt and unit_id = @unit_id update @tbl set ty_gia = b.ty_gia, dien_giai = b.dien_giai, id_tt = a.id, so_ct = b.so_ct, ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, ma_ct = b.ma_ct, unit_id = b.unit_id, status = b.status from @tbl a join #pchi b on 1 = 1 update @tbl set tt = tt_nt*ty_gia, id = @id, loai_tt = 1 select id_tt as id into #wf from ctcq20 where id = @id and loai_tt = 1
delete ctcq20 where id = @id and loai_tt = 1 insert into ctcq20 select * from @tbl
insert into #wf select id_tt as id from @tbl where id_tt not in (select id from #wf) select id, ma_unit into #xwf from ctquy20 where id = @id and ma_unit = @ma_unit exec ss_Calc_WriteOff_fund '#wf', 'ctcq20', '#xwf', 'ctquy20'
drop table #pchi, #wf, #xwf select '$Processed' as toast
select id_tt as id into #wf from ctcq20 where id = @id and ma_unit = @ma_unit and loai_tt = 1 select id, ma_unit into #xwf from ctquy20 where id = @id and ma_unit = @ma_unit delete ctcq20 where id = @id and ma_unit = @ma_unit and loai_tt = 1
exec ss_Calc_WriteOff_fund '#wf', 'ctcq20', '#xwf', 'ctquy20'
drop table #wf, #xwf select '$Processed' as toast
&VoucherJSLoading;
